title: Multi-Output Soft Sensor with a Multivariate Filter That Predicts Errors Applied to an Industrial Reactive Distillation Process
authors: Vladimir Klimchenko; Andrei Torgashov; Yuri A. W. Shardt; Fan Yang
reliability_note: Open-access publisher page was checked. The method is demonstrated on an industrial reactive distillation soft-sensor problem; transfer to other processes requires re-validation.
